pr_body:
The test fails when soft-deletes is disabled and deletes are processed out of order.

Closes #66869

review_comment: I struggle to see how this line can have any effect? If we have an `Index` entry in the map, we must have already set `hasChanges = true` above?
This line avoids a situation where we have two deletes of the same document id. In that case `hasChanges` should stay intact.
